0022600209.text: The Suns, who are 2-5 overall and 2-2 at home, host the 7-2 Spurs, who have won seven straight and sit 2nd in the Southwest. Phoenix is 12th in the West and 4.5 games back in the Pacific, and Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Mark Williams (shoulder surgery) are out for the Suns, while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27 and split their 2025-26 series 2-2, with the most recent meeting on March 19, 2026, in San Antonio, where the Suns lost 101-100.
